name: wordtoolkit
description: Token-lean native Microsoft Word automation with 15 core/gateway tools and lazy access to 146 native actions.

interface.longDescription: WordToolkit controls the real Microsoft Word application through one persistent native .NET COM STA thread. A small 15-tool MCP surface covers the common lifecycle and batch path; capability, search, inspect and execute gateways negotiate the versioned contract and load any of 146 native actions only when needed. A frozen allowlisted extension registry versions engine and capability interfaces, constrains permissions and resources, and exposes a content-free SHA-256-bound catalog; production modules route Microsoft Open XML SDK validation and explicitly configured local Tesseract OCR through the same policy. A cross-platform LibreOffice layer keeps bounded exact-binary identity probing separate from a one-shot Java UNO Writer renderer with a private profile, embedded source-rebuilt helper, explicit filters, source-drift checks, explicit non-template instantiation for DOTX/DOTM and transactional PDF/PNG/manifest publication; macro/update prevention, Microsoft Word layout fidelity and process/network sandboxing remain explicitly unclaimed. OCR candidate discovery is source-linked, signature-checked and fingerprint-bound; local-only recognition streams selected embedded images through stdin, returns bounded confidence/geometry/provenance and gates text/hashes separately without opening Word or fetching external targets. It performs no arbitrary DLL discovery, and trusted in-process execution or a spawned OCR child is not called a sandbox. An opt-in observability spine records only registered operation identity, fixed effects, outcomes, normalized error codes and bounded hashes; arguments, document content and paths are excluded, network export is absent, sink I/O is asynchronous, and the unauthenticated append chain is not presented as compliance evidence. Compact responses omit echoed input and diagnostics by default. The full action set covers one content-free, fingerprint-bound high-level document analysis that combines package, semantic, dependency, lint, active-content and markup-compatibility counts into bounded exact next-action signals without returning text or opening Word, password-free bounded detection of standard, agile, extensible, partial and malformed encrypted OOXML compound containers and caption associations, content controls, Custom XML stores, binding targets, repeating sections, nested tables, vertical-merge topology and typed active-content declarations/payloads/ActiveX bindings with a deterministic operation-wide ZIP/OPC/projection resource lease plus an independent graph-local byte budget and compact adjacency, bounded privacy-redacted active-content metadata comments/threads/people/revisions/moves/permissions, body-only comment rewriting with stable IDs and metadata invariants, deterministic equation-paragraph text-slot rewrites around exact-byte immutable OfficeMath anchors with structure/inverse/SDK proof, modeled effective formatting, atomic style-definition creation/cloning/exact consolidation/proven-unused deletion/primary-name rename, deterministic stable-ID template-style closure alignment and assignment, guarded text edits and lossless tracked-revision decisions plus live formatting, Find/replace, review, tables, formulas, lists, bookmarks, fields, images, notes, headers/footers, editable Office Math, exact scratch-document equation preflight, semantic LaTeX normalization, token-bound point equation updates, stable semantic staging drift classification, whole-package verified offline-to-live publication, verified native plain/bold/italic/bold-italic MathML and OMML equation scopes, structures, layout, Undo, PDF and Open XML validation. Semantic HTML and SVG never load external relationships or execute active content, keep links inert and use visible placeholders for unsupported descendants; neither is a pagination or Word-layout engine, and SVG reports estimated text metrics and denies pixel-equivalence claims. Dependency keys, SmartArt model keys/source, active-content names/targets/hashes/source, custom-property names/values/hashes/source, XML binding details, table names/layout/source, chart titles/formulas, custom namespace details and other source locations are redacted by default, coverage gaps remain explicit and external targets are never followed. Formatter, lint repair, numbering repair, note repair, relationship repair, semantic style mutation, template style alignment, comment body mutation, equation paragraph mutation, patch and merge application use exact fingerprints and baseline-aware validation; unsafe consumers and ambiguity fail closed. Formatter, lint repair and merge create a new file and never overwrite, while numbering, note, relationship, semantic style, template style, comment body and equation paragraph apply use an atomic recovery backup. Patch and merge retain independent active-content/signature/external-link/binary/error authorizations, while formatter, lint repair, numbering repair, note repair, relationship repair, semantic style, template style, comment body and equation paragraph apply block signed packages outright. Raw patches are confidential; an optional engine envelope supports AES-256-GCM and ECDSA-SHA256 with caller-managed keys, while MCP key provisioning remains intentionally absent. The installed Word object model remains policy-gated; macros, DDE, unsafe raw COM paths and external effects fail closed. The package contains no Python runtime.

defaultPrompt: Open or connect to my Word document and edit it live.
Create a new Word document and write this content immediately.
Generate a long document in one fast native batch.
Add a step-by-step solution with native editable equations.
Add images, comments, footnotes, headers and footers, then export a PDF.
Inspect a saved DOCX and safely accept or reject selected tracked changes.
Analyze a saved Word package broadly, without returning its text, and route me to the exact narrow inspector needed next.
Lint a saved DOCX and safely repair an empty document title into a new file.
Compare two saved Word documents semantically without opening Word.
Create and safely apply a reversible patch between two saved Word documents.
Consolidate proven exact duplicate custom styles in a saved Word document.
Delete proven-unused custom styles from a saved Word document.
Inspect, plan and atomically align selected stable-ID style dependency closures from a separate Word template without attaching or mutating it.
Inspect AlternateContent and compatibility rules without rewriting the saved package.
Inspect table grids, merges, nesting and floating position without returning cell text.
Inspect OLE, ActiveX, VBA, embedded-package and signature metadata without executing or decoding active content.
Inspect native SmartArt points, connections and related parts without returning point text or running Office layout.
Inspect floating, inline, grouped and SmartArt layout calculated by the connected Microsoft Word build.
Safely replace selected SmartArt node text through Word with stale-token checks and rollback.
Insert native captions for selected figures or tables and build an editable table of figures.
Mark selected legal citations and build an editable all-category table of authorities with verified dotted leaders.
Mark selected index terms and build an editable native index with verified Word options.
Refresh existing tables of contents, figures, authorities and indexes through one guarded Word transaction.
Rewrite only selected saved-DOCX comment bodies without changing anchors or thread metadata.
Rewrite only the ordinary text slots around immutable OfficeMath in one selected saved-DOCX paragraph.
Convert a saved Word package to or from bounded Flat OPC XML without opening Word.
Inspect the registered engine extensions, interface versions, permissions and resource limits without loading assemblies or reading a document.
Inspect embedded Word image OCR candidates without returning image bytes or opening Word.
Recognize selected fingerprint-bound Word images with local-only OCR and bounded provenance.
Inspect bounded content-free runtime health without returning arguments, document content or paths.
Detect a standard, agile, extensible or malformed encrypted OOXML container without requesting a password or decrypting content.
Execute saved-DOCX list counters and inspect exact labels without opening Word or returning paragraph text.
Restart one reviewed saved-DOCX numbering tail atomically without returning paragraph text or raw XML.
Inspect exact paragraphs, then reconstruct a reviewed single- or multilevel numbering definition without returning paragraph text or raw XML.
Inspect saved footnotes and endnotes, then atomically remove one reviewed empty orphan or redundant duplicate without returning note text or raw XML.
Inspect and atomically remove reviewed dead OPC relationships without returning external targets or raw XML.
Inspect, plan and atomically remove only canonically identical duplicate OfficeMath properties from a saved Word package.
Inspect the typed Word heading hierarchy without guessing from localized style names or returning heading text by default.
Find conservative theorem, lemma, definition and proof paragraph candidates without claiming semantic completeness or returning paragraph text by default.
Qualify one explicit LibreOffice executable by version and SHA-256 without opening a document or claiming render capability.

Render an exact saved Word package through isolated LibreOffice Writer to a transactionally published PDF, optional PNG pages and a provenance manifest without claiming Microsoft Word layout fidelity.
Render a saved Word package to deterministic semantic HTML without opening Word or claiming page fidelity.
Render only one fingerprint-bound semantic table, equation or other document subtree to HTML.
Render one fingerprint-bound semantic table, equation or other supported subtree to static SVG without claiming Word pixels.
Render an exact saved Word package or page range to transactionally published Word PDF and Poppler-derived PNG artifacts.
